zh-CN.The expensive mistake is copying a tall: The expensive mistake is copying a tall bookcase proportion into child-height furniture without checking tip resistance. Catch it before material is ordered, parts are cut, tile is mixed, or fabric is committed. A controlled sample, full-size sketch, dry layout, or one verified module is cheaper than correcting an entire batch.
zh-CN.The target outcome is a simple open shel: The target outcome is a simple open shelf with accessible bays and a safety-first installation plan. If any assumption remains uncertain, label it and keep enough flexibility in the plan to verify it on site.
